workUnits.name: Capture runtime evidence and feedback for governed learning
workUnits.purpose: Persist governed execution evidence and runtime-feedback linkage.
workUnits.trigger: Canonical resolution reaches a declared after-state.
atomicActions: Capture transport document/object graph, resolution evidence, source claims, validation results, exception/HITL record, crosswalk, binding status and feedback linkage.
evidenceRequirements: Task-level evidence set declared by frozen LTL-03 source.
workUnits.outputState: Governed execution evidence and runtime-feedback linkage are retained.

workUnits.name: Resolve Shipper/Consignor, Consignee and BillTo party instances
workUnits.purpose: Resolve party roles and instantiate canonical Party instances.
workUnits.trigger: Canonical Consignment exists and source evidence contains party-role information.
atomicActions: Identify Shipper/Consignor, Consignee and BillTo role blocks and instantiate/associate canonical Party instances.
evidenceRequirements: Source evidence identifying each resolved party role and values.
workUnits.outputState: Canonical Party instances are associated to the Consignment.

workUnits.name: Resolve client-specific party code and account semantics
workUnits.purpose: Resolve Shipper Code and exact Bill To/Consignee account semantics only from governing client/schema evidence.

blockingReasons: Frozen baseline explicitly classifies these semantics as client binding required.

workUnits.name: Resolve canonical HandlingUnit hierarchy and count/type association
workUnits.purpose: Resolve handling-unit structure before accepting count/type and keep handling units distinct from pieces.
workUnits.trigger: Handling-unit evidence is present for the active Consignment.
atomicActions: Resolve HandlingUnit hierarchy/association before accepting handling-unit count/type; do not substitute line-item piece counts.
evidenceRequirements: Source structure establishing HandlingUnit hierarchy and count/type association.
workUnits.outputState: HandlingUnit structure and count/type association are resolved or a conflict is raised.

workUnits.name: Resolve Handling Unit Line No semantics
workUnits.purpose: Resolve Handling Unit Line No only when source-context semantics are governed.

blockingReasons: Frozen baseline explicitly marks Handling Unit Line No as SOURCE_CONTEXT_PENDING.

workUnits.name: Instantiate and associate canonical LineItem objects
workUnits.purpose: Instantiate LineItem objects and associate them to resolved HandlingUnit/Consignment hierarchy.
workUnits.trigger: Line-item evidence is present and its containing context is resolved.
atomicActions: Instantiate canonical LineItem instances and associate each to its resolved HandlingUnit or Consignment.
evidenceRequirements: Source evidence identifying each LineItem and hierarchy association.
workUnits.outputState: LineItems are instantiated and associated to canonical hierarchy.

workUnits.name: Validate Line Item Piece Count independently from Handling Unit Count
workUnits.purpose: Apply the frozen rule that line-item piece count and handling-unit count are distinct concepts.
workUnits.trigger: A LineItem carries a source piece-count value and hierarchy is resolved.
atomicActions: Validate Line Item Piece Count independently of Handling Unit Count/Type.
evidenceRequirements: Source piece-count value and resolved hierarchy.
workUnits.outputState: Piece count is validated as distinct from handling-unit count or conflict is raised.

workUnits.name: Classify DangerousGoods applicability
workUnits.purpose: Use source-backed hazardous-entry evidence and active regulatory context to determine conditional DangerousGoods applicability.
workUnits.trigger: A resolved LineItem contains hazardous-indicator/equivalent evidence and applicable context is known.
decisionGates: Apply source-backed hazardous-entry identification only within its stated applicability; do not universalize it.
workUnits.outputState: DangerousGoods applicability is determined for the LineItem.

workUnits.name: Resolve associated DangerousGoods conditional object family
workUnits.purpose: Resolve hazardous basic-description family as one associated object with conditional technical-name/zone and emergency-response evidence where applicable.
workUnits.trigger: DangerousGoods applicability is established for a LineItem.
atomicActions: Resolve identification number, proper shipping name, hazard class/division, packing group where applicable, conditional technical name/zone, and emergency-response information as one associated family.
evidenceRequirements: Source evidence for the linked DangerousGoods family and conditional applicability.
workUnits.outputState: One associated DangerousGoods object family is resolved and linked to the LineItem.

workUnits.name: Instantiate canonical Instruction objects
workUnits.purpose: Instantiate canonical Instruction objects while keeping unresolved exact client value sets explicit.
workUnits.trigger: Instruction evidence is present for the active Consignment.
atomicActions: Instantiate canonical Instruction objects and associate them to the Consignment without inventing unresolved client-specific type values.
evidenceRequirements: Source instruction evidence and binding status for unresolved exact type values.
workUnits.outputState: Instruction objects exist; unresolved exact type vocabulary remains CLIENT_BINDING_REQUIRED.
